name: WF-141 Portfolio Intelligence → Underwriting Calibration & Strategy Feedback

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deals=Array.isArray(input.closed_deals)?input.closed_deals:(Array.isArray(input.deals)?input.deals:[]); const rows=deals.map(d=>{const e=d.economics??d.performance??{}; const expected=Number(e.expected_net_profit??e.projected_net_profit??d.expected_net_profit??0); const actual=Number(e.actual_net_profit??e.realized_net_profit??e.net_profit??d.actual_net_profit??0); const days=Number(d.days_to_close??e.days_to_close??0); return {...d,variance:actual-expected,variance_pct:expected?((actual-expected)/Math.abs(expected)):null,actual_net_profit:actual,days_to_close:days};}); const count=rows.length; const avgProfit=count?rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.actual_net_profit,0)/count:0; const avgVariance=count?rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.variance,0)/count:0; const avgDays=count?rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.days_to_close,0)/count:0; const profitable=rows.filter(r=>r.actual_net_profit>0).length; const lossRate=count?1-profitable/count:null; const calibration={sample_size:count,average_realized_profit:avgProfit,average_profit_variance:avgVariance,average_days_to_close:avgDays,loss_rate:lossRate,profitability_rate:count?profitable/count:null}; const recommendations=[]; if(avgVariance<0) recommendations.push('Review projected profit assumptions and cost buffers'); if(avgDays>45) recommendations.push('Review closing timeline assumptions and milestone buffers'); if(lossRate!==null&&lossRate>0.25) recommendations.push('Tighten acquisition and exit qualification thresholds'); if(!recommendations.length) recommendations.push('Maintain current underwriting guardrails and continue collecting realized outcomes'); const status=count?'calibration_ready':'insufficient_sample'; const route=count?'underwriting_calibration_update':'data_collection'; return [{json:{workflow_id:'WF-141',workflow_name:'Portfolio Intelligence → Underwriting Calibration & Strategy Feedback',status,route,calibration,recommendations,deal_observations:rows.slice(0,100),next_workflow:route==='underwriting_calibration_update'?'WF-069 deal viability/MAO strategy gate':'WF-140 portfolio performance intelligence',crm_activity:{event_type:'portfolio_underwriting_calibration',outcome:status,route,sample_size:count},idempotency_key:'wf-141:underwriting-calibration:'+(input.portfolio_id??input.event_id??'default')}}}];
